purpose: One chooser for the value or values of a qualifier: the defined options with their definitions as hints, ALL ("every value"), a free-text "Other…" and Clear.
namedChanges: Comments made generic (internal tags removed from the header comment and from the `notInScale` comment).

Code verbatim except the two imports: `./PlanButtonRow` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-button-row`, and `../../lib/base/planValue` (`ALL_VALUE`, `packQualifierValues`, `qualifierValues`) is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-qualifier-values`.

library.title: Qualifier value picker
library.note: Picks the value(s) of one Scale qualifier; to edit the qualifiers themselves take value-qualifiers-line. Plan.Value
